blocks.text: A slot leaves a place where a parent can supply page content. It makes a wrapper reusable.
Use a Vue 3 project made with the official create-vue tool. Put single-file examples in App.vue unless file names say otherwise. These need the Vue build tool and do not run in the plain playground.

blocks.title: Leave a slot for content

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A slot marks where caller-supplied content is displayed. Text inside a slot is fallback content when that slot is empty.

blocks.text: The supplied paragraph appears inside the note box after its heading.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Slot content belongs to the parent that supplies it. Use props when you need a named data value instead.
